results: Area tiers change only at declared zoom thresholds
Spatial selection includes date-line crossings and repeated world copies
Delta decoding preserves closed rings and polygon holes
Concurrent comparison maps share one request
Failed and malformed shards leave the cache retryable
Completed LRU entries stay within the vertex budget
The overview survives decoding and worker loading until the current tiles are ready
Moving invalidates readiness and prevents a stale response from drawing
A late earlier viewport cannot replace a newer one
Small pans within the loaded margin retain fine shores without another fetch
A failed shard retains the overview and retry succeeds
Modern reference and disabled geography do not request natural lake detail
Late work after map destruction never mutates the removed map
Invisible globe-side event markers do not suppress lake names; visible markers keep priority
All archive shards have valid hashes, counts, class exclusions and coordinate encoding
